# United Kingdom Lasting Power of Attorney for Health and Care Decisions

> A digital implementation of the statutory **Lasting Power of Attorney for Health and Welfare** (statutory form **LP1H**) under the **Mental Capacity Act 2005** (England and Wales). The donor — or a solicitor, attorney, or advocate acting on their behalf — completes a single-page **14-step wizard** that captures every field of the paper LP1H form, applies a deterministic statutory-validity engine, raises compliance flags, and emits a registration-ready application bundle for the **Office of the Public Guardian (OPG)**.
